corrections.source: funet; Butterflies of America: H. lycaste dionaea (Hewitson 1854)

dataset_correct_over_gbif.actinote dicaeus: Altinote is a junior synonym of Actinote (Lamas 2004; molecular phylogenetics)
dataset_correct_over_gbif.actinote ozomene: Altinote is a junior synonym of Actinote (Lamas 2004)
dataset_correct_over_gbif.elzunia humboldt: Original spelling by Latreille (1809); ICZN Art. 32 preserves original
dataset_correct_over_gbif.heliconius numata: Noun in apposition (ICZN Art. 31.2.2); all specialist literature uses numata
dataset_correct_over_gbif.hyalenna perasippa: Willmott & Lamas (2006) revision consistently uses perasippa
dataset_correct_over_gbif.ithomia leila: Noun in apposition; Butterflies of America, iNaturalist, nymphalidae.net
dataset_correct_over_gbif.patricia oligyrtis: olygyrtis is a letter-transposition error in GBIF
dataset_correct_over_gbif.episcada hymen: FALSE POSITIVE: E. hymen (Haensch 1905) and E. hymenaea (Prittwitz 1865) are different valid species
dataset_correct_over_gbif.hyalyris schlingeri: Correct genus is Hyalyris Boisduval 1870 (with y); Hyalaris is GBIF error
dataset_correct_over_gbif.anteros bracteata: Dataset follows specialist usage; GBIF form is DOUBTFUL
dataset_correct_over_gbif.euptychia westwoodi: Dataset follows specialist usage; GBIF form is SYNONYM
dataset_correct_over_gbif.eurybia nicaeus: Dataset follows specialist usage; GBIF form is DOUBTFUL
